resources.string: Use sleep summaries for workout suggestions

Use fresh sleep summaries you manually synced to suggest a shorter existing workout when recorded sleep is below your recent recorded baseline. At least three previous days with comparable sync times are needed. Summaries may be incomplete and do not diagnose recovery.\n\nBaseline observations and the last 20 recommendation explanations are kept only on this device for your account, excluded from backup. You can keep the usual workout. Disabling this option removes the saved baseline and explanations. Calorie goals, nutrient targets, heart-rate data and exercise calories are not changed.
